## **Prix et paywall** {#theme-pricing_paywall}

<!--ir-theme:pricing_paywall-->
   **Prix et paywall.**
      4 avis récents mentionnent prix et paywall.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 8 sept. 2026 - 15 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent prix, abonnements ou paywalls. Cela peut signaler une sensibilité au pricing dans la niche.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Erin Love_, 15 sept. 2026, 1/5: "I have canceled my subscription through Google Play. Store, as the app requires you to do. And I'm still being charged month after month. Getting to customer service, there's no easy way. How some of the reviews on here are so high, It's unbelievable. There's no easy way to cancel your account. The only way I can see is to cancel the account through google play service and then turn around and block each and every charge."
            2. _Arlene Mingils_, 14 sept. 2026, 1/5: "Not clear on pricing! Beware ⚠️. I never received an answer on how much I was being charged!! I was just told that they would cancel my subscription 😡"
            3. _Patricia LeVay_, 8 sept. 2026, 2/5: "too expensive. had to cancel my subscriptiom."
<!--/ir-theme-->

## **Bugs et stabilité** {#theme-bugs_stability}

<!--ir-theme:bugs_stability-->
   **Bugs et stabilité.**
      2 avis récents mentionnent bugs et stabilité.
      Fenêtre d'avis : 13 juin 2026 - 14 sept. 2026
      **Pourquoi c'est important:** Les utilisateurs mentionnent des crashes ou de l'instabilité. À traiter comme actionnable seulement en cas de pic ou après une mise à jour ; sinon souvent du bruit de baseline.

         **Exemples d'avis:**
            1. _Mel_, 13 juin 2026, 1/5: "Bug d'application complète. Tentative de prélever un deuxième montant sans mon autorisation de plus de 60 euro. méfier vous. mais le pire c est que 2 mois plutard. il tente encore de vous voler des montant entre 50 et 60 euro. Pas d échéance j ai bloqué la carte. à fuire"
            2. _Wanda Fay_, 14 sept. 2026, 4/5: "How do I get the Print out sheet for Tai Chi Chair Yoga? Can't find it in the Lasta App? Did My first workout and I have to say it was a lot more difficult than I thought it would be. I have Balance issues so it makes it more difficult for me."
            3. _Liz_, 13 sept. 2026, 4/5: "the experience has been very interesting. had a little issue but with some great help from the support section especially from Lily Cole everything was sorted out very quickly. many thanks Lily"
<!--/ir-theme-->
